note: Traps and events for The Hedge. Schema and types: see TRAPS.md in this folder. Add entries; no code change needed.

lines: Huh. This stretch feels long.
Wait. Didn't I already pass that pumpkin?
Okay. The hedge is definitely laughing at me.
...fine. The hedge lets you pass. This time.

params.text:
WELCOME TO THE HEDGE
Please do not feed
the shadows.

lines: The sign is very polite. That is somehow worse.

params.text:
TURN BACK
(this sign is legally
required to say that)

lines: You do not turn back. The sign sighs.
EXIT? Nope. The hedge thanks you for visiting its closet.
(a whisper, very close) ...left... no... your other left...
Boo. Sorry. It does that.
The lanterns hold their breath...
...and let it out.
Your legs have joined the other team for a moment.
...it blinked. It was just a blink. Probably.
A gap in the hedge. It looks like it has been waiting for you.

params.text:
You are here.
Unfortunately, so is
something else.

lines: Signed: Terra.
The lanterns blink out. Something nearby whispers, “Shh.”
A golden searchlight snaps right onto you! ...Just kidding. Not yet.

params.text:
DEAD END. The Eye
watched you walk all
the way down here. It
is thoroughly

lines: Signed: Gemini.
Lantern dies. Total blackness. Whatever is shuffling behind you is getting closer.
Seven seconds. Keep your hands where the dark can't count them.

params.text:
Excellent progress.
Please enjoy making
it again.

lines: Kimi left this. Kimi is enjoying this.

params.text:

5-star review, or
become a permanent
feature.

lines: Signed: Kimi.

params.text:
Haven't we met? This
hedge remembers you.

lines: Progress is a loop. Ask any software update.
EXIT (beta). Thank you for testing. Please start again.
The Eye isn't looking for you. It's looking at what's behind you.

params.text:

lines: Signed: Jarons Twin.

params.text:

you passed this exact
hedge already.

lines: Recounting... same hedge, same fog. Logged it. Moving on. Again.
EXIT (unverified, per my records)
Correction logged: that was not the exit. Something else was standing there.

params.text:

12%. The Eye 88%. The

lines: Signed: Darios Twin.
EXIT. Order filled. Wait... wrong side.
Losses are data. Logging you now.
Market closed. All lanterns suspended.
Something in the fog just bought your position.

params.text:
Transaction declined.
Please return to start
and try again.

lines: Declined again. The hedge charges a non-refundable fear fee.
EXIT: free trial! Auto-renews forever.
Cancel anytime. (You can't. It's a maze.)
Your soul is past due... the Eye accepts late payments.
